_comment: Customizer v2 WI-T1/WI-T3 — the design-token roles. EVERY theme that includes this fragment MUST override all five colour defaults (and check the two scales) with the literals already in its own stylesheet: the values here are emitted verbatim as --tc-*/--tr-*/--ts-* for stores that customized nothing, so a wrong default is a rendering change. See App\Services\Theme\Tokens and ThemeTokensTest, which fails if a theme leaves a default behind.

fields._comment: Customizer v2 WI-T2 — self-hosted font pairs. The options MUST equal App\Services\Theme\FontPairs::optionValues() (ThemeFontPairsTest fails otherwise); the registry itself is core/config/theme-fonts.php. The default is the "none" SENTINEL, not a pair: it emits no @font-face and no --tf-* var, so an untouched store renders exactly what it renders today. It is not "" because Alpine drops an option value bound to the empty string — see the note in config/theme-fonts.php. Every pair carries an Arabic face; the platform default locale is ar.
fields.label: Font pairing
fields.help: Self-hosted Latin + Arabic pairing. Leave on Theme default to keep the typography this theme ships with.
